create_timer_instance: create a Timer object to track elapsed time across multiple operations using tic and toc
use_timer_tic_toc: use the Timer tic and toc methods to measure and return average execution time
reset_timer_state: reset a Timer instance to zero calls and zero total time for fresh measurements
convert_seconds_to_timedelta_str: convert a time difference in seconds to a human-readable timedelta string using get_time_str
get_timer_average_time_str: get the Timer average time formatted as a timedelta string using the avg_time_str method
